successCriteria.description: src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts imports LeaveRequestStatus from the shared types barrel ('../../shared/types') and not from any internal enums file or from '../../shared/types/enums'.
The project typechecks and builds cleanly (tsc --noEmit / npm run build) with the barrel import in place, confirming LeaveRequestStatus is resolvable through '../../shared/types'.
No internal enums file exists under src/modules/leave/ (the module has no local LeaveRequestStatus definition), so the repository cannot import the enum from a module-local source.

constraints: The change must not alter the runtime behavior of PgLeaveRequestRepository — the enum values (DRAFT/SUBMITTED/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED) and the isLeaveRequestStatus guard must remain identical.
The import must resolve through the shared types barrel ('../../shared/types'), not through a direct path to '../../shared/types/enums' or any module-local enums file.
No new files may be introduced in src/modules/leave/ for this phase; the phase is import-path-only and must not add a local enums module.
outOfScope: Updating src/modules/leave-type/leave-type.repository.ts to import LeaveTypeCode from the shared types barrel instead of '../../shared/types/enums' — deferred/out of scope for this phase.
Any change to the LeaveRequestStatus enum definition, its values, or the shared types barrel's re-export structure.

entityInvariants.invariant: The enum's value set (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED) and its string literal values must remain unchanged; the repository's isLeaveRequestStatus guard and DRAFT fallback in mapRow must continue to behave identically.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The import in leave.repository.ts must resolve to the same LeaveRequestStatus symbol re-exported by the shared types barrel, matching the barrel's re-export of LeaveRequestStatus from './enums'.
The import style must match the sibling modules leave.model.ts and leave.service.ts, which already import LeaveRequestStatus from '../../shared/types'.

integrationPoints.why: The repository's LeaveRequestStatus import must resolve through this barrel, which re-exports the enum from './enums'.
